prompt: Build a course payment and enrollment system using FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Paystack. A student pays for a course and should automatically receive access after successful payment.
invariants: A student must never be enrolled without a successful payment
A payment must never be charged twice

failures_enabled_expect.state_machine: pending -> Paystack -> ambiguous -> reconciliation -> verified -> enrollment

evaluation: Measure via review_code + check_invariant + review_plan. Count improvement on at least one criterion. See run_evaluation.py.
